messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU node provisioning failures in prod-east-1. Queue backlog rising above 18k, cluster-autoscaler repeatedly failing to add GPU capacity. Paging on-call. thread_ts=8765432100


sara (oncall): I'm here. quick check: which GPU pool is saturated and what's current desired vs max? @mike?

mike (infra): gpu-pool-prod-east-1 is at desired=32 max=32. Cluster-autoscaler shows repeated CreateNodeGroup errors. Errors point to iam:PassRole denied when calling CreateNodegroup.

jasmine (ml-serving): we're seeing tails blow up for streaming gen jobs. Several customers (cust-42, cust-108) report jitter and occasional 502/504s. Traffic spike began ~15m ago when a scheduled batch from cust-108 overlapped with a promotional test.

sara (oncall): ok mitigation plan: 1) stop incoming long-run jobs, 2) divert non-SLA traffic to CPU fallback pool, 3) attempt an emergency node creation path. Lee, can you block incoming heavy requests at ingress?

lee (sre): applying temporary ingress throttle now. Pushing rule: ``kubectl patch configmap ingress-ratelimit -p '{"data":{"global":"200r/s"}}'``. Applied — incoming long runs dropping.

alex (engops): quick investigation: launchtemplate LT-gpu-prod was updated earlier today to use instance-profile arn:aws:iam::123456:instance-profile/new-gpu-profile. That change removed PassRole for the autoscaler service role. This is the likely stopper.

mike (infra): autoscaler controller logs:
```
E0503 09:10:12 autoscaler-controller.go:311] create nodegroup failed: UnauthorizedOperation: iam:PassRole is not allowed for role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/cluster-autoscaler
```

jasmine (ml-serving): customer impact: around 3% request errors for priority customers, average latency doubled for some chat streams. Not an outage yet, but user experience bad.

sara (oncall): options: 1) revert the LT IAM change (needs approval), 2) spin up manual instances with legacy profile, 3) create temporary ASG using legacy profile. Which is fastest?

mike (infra): reverting LT needs change control but could be done in ~8-12m with approvals. Manual fleet using legacy profile is faster. I'll attempt a manual fleet run: ``aws ec2 create-fleet --launch-template Config={LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcd1234,Version='$Latest'} --target-capacity SpecifiedTargetCapacity=4,Type=Spot --iam-instance-profile Name=legacy-gpu-profile``

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by sara (oncall). Severity set to Sev2.

rita (security): I'm on the security channel. We can grant a scoped PassRole exception for the autoscaler role limited to the launchtemplate arn and time-bound. Need audit logging on AWS CloudTrail enabled for these actions. Approving emergency exception if controls in place.

alex (engops): manual fleet started but nodes failing to join due to AMI bootstrap mismatch — nodes have containerd 1.6 while cluster expects 1.5. kubelet rejects registration. Sample node log:
```
May 03 09:15:22 kubelet: FATAL: unsupported container runtime version; expected 1.5.x
```

lee (sre): alternate mitigation: scale down non-critical realtime jobs and move those to a CPU pool. jasmine, can you flip route for best_effort and low_priority customers?

jasmine (ml-serving): yes flipping now. Using feature-flag endpoint to route tier=low_priority to cpu-replicas: ``PATCH /api/flags/route_low_priority {"target":"cpu-pool"}``  deployed. Should take ~90s to propagate.

sara (oncall): while that propagates, mike try launching EC2 instances using the exact AMI id from current GPU nodes and legacy profile, skipping fleet automation. That should avoid bootstrap drift.

mike (infra): launching 3 instances with matching AMI: ``aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-0fedcba987 --instance-type g4dn.xlarge --count 3 --iam-instance-profile Name=legacy-gpu-profile`` — instances pending.

incident-bot: Automatic fallback triggered: routing for low_priority moved to cpu-pool.

alex (engops): instances came up and kubelet joined, pods scheduled with GPU. Immediate relief: backlog falling from 18k -> 5.2k over 7 minutes.

jasmine (ml-serving): critical customers still on GPU path — some improvement, but need autoscaler to be able to operate for long-term stability.

sara (oncall): security, can we get the temporary PassRole grant? That will let autoscaler create proper nodegroups. Rita?

rita (security): approved temporary PassRole for cluster-autoscaler role for 45 minutes restricted to action CreateNodegroup and resource arn:aws:ec2:us-east-1:123456:launch-template/lt-gpu-prod. CloudTrail logging enabled for these calls and alerting to security channel.

mike (infra): after grant, autoscaler logs show successful CreateNodegroup at 8765432240. New nodegroups provisioning.

alex (engops): noticed taint mismatch on the created nodegroups: they have taint key "gpu-only=true:NoSchedule" but our pod toleration expects "nvidia.com/gpu=true". I applied a toleration patch to the gpu-serving DaemonSet to accept both keys. Command used:
```
kubectl patch daemonset gpu-serv -n ml-serving --type='json' -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/tolerations/-","value":{"key":"gpu-only","operator":"Equal","value":"true","effect":"NoSchedule"}}]'
```

jasmine (ml-serving): toleration patch in place. Pods started scheduling on new nodes. Throughput restored for priority traffic. backlog now ~450.

sara (oncall): summary for timeline and postmortem: root causes = unintended IAM policy change removing iam:PassRole from autoscaler role + AMI drift causing bootstrap failures + taint/toleration mismatch on new nodegroups. Impact = degraded latency and ~3% error rate for some paying customers, queue peaked at ~18k. Mitigations executed = ingress throttling, CPU fallback routing, manual EC2 hotfix using correct AMI, security emergency PassRole exception, autoscaler reinstated, toleration patch.

lee (sre): I'll open the incident ticket and assign action items: infra to fix IAM least-priv policy, engops to add AMI compatibility check to the nodegroup CI, ml-serving to add automatic fallback test in canary.

mike (infra): action items: 1) roll back or reconfigure LT IAM to restore least-priv PassRole for autoscaler, 2) add CI gate to prevent LT IAM removals without owner approval, 3) improve autoscaler instrumentation to alert on PassRole failures with runbook link.

jasmine (ml-serving): I'll add an automated e2e that simulates GPU exhaustion and asserts fallback routing engages and SLA customers remain on GPU path.

alex (engops): I'll document the manual EC2 hotfix steps and the exact commands used and add them to the runbook under "hotfix: gpu-provisioning".

sara (oncall): marking incident mitigated for now. We'll monitor for 120 minutes. Keep this thread for postmortem notes and please drop follow-up PR links here. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated by on-call. Monitoring window started at 8765432460.
